Title: Sanjay's Day

Cast

1. Sanjay - 29 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Sonali - 61 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Kavita - 25 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Vinod - 39 years, general
Look: iron armour, red turban

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Sanjay stands on the battlefield. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Sanjay is struck by a spear and dies on the battlefield.]

Sonali: "Rest in peace."
